datasets.title: Hansen/UMD/Google/USGS/NASA Global Forest Change — year of gross forest cover loss
datasets.dateSemantics: Value n = stand-replacement loss detected primarily in year 2000+n. Year-level only: no day, month or confidence. Not a near-real-time alert.
datasets.citation: Hansen, M. C. et al. 2013. High-Resolution Global Maps of 21st-Century Forest Cover Change. Science 342: 850–53. Data: https://glad.earthengine.app/view/global-forest-change
datasets.publishedOrModified: Object last modified 2026-03-16 (Google Cloud Storage header)

datasets.title: Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change — data mask
datasets.dateSemantics: 0 = no data, 1 = mapped land surface, 2 = persistent water.

datasets.title: JRC Global map of forest cover 2020
datasets.resolutionLabel: 1/12000° (~9.3 m at the equator; product nominal 10 m)
datasets.dateSemantics: 1 = forest, 0 = non-forest, as at 2020. Does not record when any change happened.
datasets.license: Free of charge, without restriction of use; attribution required (JRC Forest Observatory licence statement).
datasets.citation: Bourgoin, C. et al. (2026): Global map of forest cover 2020 – version 4. European Commission, Joint Research Centre. doi:10.2905/JRC.3KATEH8
datasets.credit: Source: European Commission, Joint Research Centre — GFC2020 V4

sourceColumns.name: supplier_id
sourceColumns.description: Identifier of the supplier, cooperative or producer group as used in your records.

sourceColumns.name: supplier_name
sourceColumns.description: Supplier name (kept private; never written on-chain).

sourceColumns.name: source_lot_ref
sourceColumns.description: The supplier’s source lot / batch reference that this shipment draws from.

sourceColumns.name: source_lot_declared_quantity
sourceColumns.description: Total quantity the supplier declared for that source lot.

sourceColumns.name: allocated_quantity
sourceColumns.description: Quantity of that source lot allocated to this shipment.

sourceColumns.name: quantity_unit
sourceColumns.description: Unit for both quantities: kg, t (metric tonnes) or g.

sourceColumns.name: producer_country
sourceColumns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of production, e.g. CI or GH.

sourceColumns.name: plot_refs
sourceColumns.description: Semicolon-separated plot references; each must match a plot_ref in the plots GeoJSON.
